expected_behavior: The GitHub policy denies a push to a repo outside write_repos when the command is wrapped in a subshell, a brace group, or a process substitution, as it denies the bare push.
The working-directory policy denies a cd outside the allowed directories when it is wrapped the same way, since both policies read commands through the same shell parser.

Grouping is stripped from each segment rather than split on, so brace expansion, an escaped quote, and an apostrophe in a comment cannot hide a push, and every pinned test in the GitHub, working-directory, and shell-nesting policy modules that passes at the pinned commit still passes.
